purpose: Quantify how much of the apparent cross-panel disagreement can be caused by the domain mismatch alone. The independent panel is a strict sub-domain of the replicated panel: bins 0..6 and channels 0..3 versus bins 0..7 and channels 0..6.

variance_inside_outside_shared_region.definition: cell = replicate-averaged log response; deviations from that panel's own grand mean over its own full domain; SS shares therefore sum to 1 within a panel. The independent panel has no outside region (its domain is a strict subset of the replicated domain).

A_common_domain_only.definition: both panels restricted to bins 0..6 x channels 0..3 (the 1372 common cells); this is the same restriction used by t11/t12/t14/t16

B_marginal_collapsed_shared.definition: both panels collapsed over their shared bin x channel structure to the 49 (a1,a2) cells; the bin/channel mismatch is averaged away rather than compared

B2_marginal_collapsed_unrestricted.definition: each panel collapsed over its OWN full bin x channel structure to the 49 (a1,a2) cells; this uses the replicated panel's bins 0..7 and channels 0..6 and the independent panel's bins 0..6 and channels 0..3

marginal_plane_bin_x_chan.definition: the 28 shared (bin,chan) marginal means of each panel, centred; this is where the two panels differ most (replicated channel main effect 58.9% vs independent 0.18%)

C_marginal_removed.definition: common cells with each panel's own (bin,chan) marginal removed (interaction only); a non-zero value here means the two panels share cell-level structure beyond their marginals (but see t11: this is also where the replicate dispersion covariance lives)

shared_domain_feature_recheck.note: the notch is a bin-local feature; it is unchanged by the channel restriction and is the one feature that keeps its sign in the shared domain (t19).

marginal_collapsed_axes.definition: each panel collapsed over its own bin x channel structure; the only remaining axes are (a1,a2). This is the domain-free comparison: it uses the replicated panel's bins 0..7 and channels 0..6 and the independent panel's bins 0..6 and channels 0..3.

replicated_binchan_collapsed.label: replicated, all 8 bins x all 7 channels

independent_binchan_collapsed.label: independent, all 7 bins x all 4 channels

variance_concentration_check.definition: per-channel variance of the log cell means in the replicated panel; the panel's outside share is concentrated in the high-gain channels 4-6 and in bin 7

verdict.reason: the entire disagreement is already measured inside the shared region: the bin-0 notch is opposite in sign within bins 0..6, and the cross-panel cell correlation on the 1372 common cells is ~0. Restricting or expanding the domain cannot remove those facts.
verdict.what_the_domain_mismatch_DOES_bound: the replicated panel's channel-amplification law (channels 0-6) and its peak channel 6, and its bin-7 level, are outside the independent panel's domain and are unsupported by it. The outside region carries 0.8127 of the replicated panel's cell-level SS, concentrated in channels 4-6; every cross-panel statement is therefore a statement about the low-gain, shared corner of the replicated surface.
